Return on Effort

Every dataset ranked by value against effort to migrate

Each dataset is scored on the value of moving it (how widely it is consumed and how much data it carries) against the effort to move it (transformation and dependency complexity). Together they place every dataset on the map below, from Excellent quick wins in the top-left to Poor in the bottom-right.
